name: MCE API Log Report
query:
SELECT
  name as "Log:Link/MCE API Log:150",
  api_name as "API Name:Data:200",
  api_type as "Direction:Data:80",
  application_status as "Status:Data:110",
  status_code as "HTTP Status:Int:90",
  total_records as "Total:Int:70",
  accepted_records as "Accepted:Int:80",
  rejected_records as "Rejected:Int:80",
  processing_duration as "Duration (s):Float:100",
  error_message as "Error:Small Text:320",
  request_timestamp as "Requested At:Datetime:160"
FROM `tabMCE API Log`
ORDER BY creation DESC
